title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat you like a demographic instead of a person.
body:
We have all been there. You open a news app and get flooded with headlines about things you do not care about. The algorithms are built to keep you clicking, not to help you understand the world. They chase trends and outrage rather than your actual interests.

True personalization is not about guessing what you might click on next. It is about respecting your time. It means delivering the stories that matter to you, in a way that helps you stay informed without the noise. When technology is used to filter out the clutter instead of adding to it, you stop scrolling and start learning.

Building a news feed that actually works requires a shift in how we think about AI. It should not be a megaphone for the loudest voices on the internet. It should be a quiet, efficient curator that learns what you value. That is the philosophy we are testing every day.
cta: You can see how we are rethinking the daily news cycle at HEADLINNE.com.
